body.description: a Mower, a lawn-care Stray: a squat robot lawn mower the size of a dog on four small rubber wheels, chipped orange plastic shell gone pale in the sun, a cracked solar panel on its back, one amber eye lamp at the front, rusted blades whirring underneath, grass stains and dents. no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
